title: Tetrametallic Divalent Samarium Cluster Hydride and Dinitrogen Complexes

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear dipyrrolide Sm(II) hydride cluster with [Na(THF)6]+ countercation

synthesis.procedure: Under N2, diphenylmethyldipyrrole (3.2 g, 10.7 mmol) in THF (200 mL) was treated at room temperature with NaH (0.5 g, 22.5 mmol) and stirred 2 h until effervescence ceased. SmCl3(THF)3 (4.9 g, 10.4 mmol) was added (instantaneous light-yellow color), and the mixture was stirred at 60 °C for 30 min. Sodium metal (0.3 g, 13.0 mmol) and catalytic C10H8 (10 mg, 78 μmol) were introduced and the mixture was stirred vigorously at room temperature for 18 h, giving a deep purple-brown solution. After filtration, toluene (75 mL) was added, the solution was concentrated to a small volume, and dark purple crystals of 1 separated on standing overnight at room temperature (2.5 g, 1.05 mmol, 39%).
synthesis.temperature: room temperature then 60 °C (30 min), then room temperature (18 h); crystallization overnight at room temperature
synthesis.time: 2 h (deprotonation); 30 min at 60 °C; 18 h reduction; overnight crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: inert N2 atmosphere (drybox or Schlenk/vacuum line)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered to remove insoluble solid; toluene added; concentrated to small volume; dark purple crystals on standing overnight at room temperature

properties.summary: Paramagnetic tetranuclear Sm(II) hydride; room-temperature magnetic moment slightly lower than expected for four Sm(II) centers, attributed to short Sm···Sm contacts.

measurements.name: μeff
measurements.conditions: room temperature, Gouy balance, diamagnetic correction applied

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear dipyrrolide dinitrogen cluster with two Na(THF) cations

synthesis.procedure: Method A: NaH (0.7 g, 30.1 mmol) was added to 1,1-cyclohexyldipyrrole (3.4 g, 15.0 mmol) in THF (150 mL) and stirred 30 min at room temperature until effervescence ceased. SmCl3(THF)3 (6.9 g, 14.6 mmol) was added (bright yellow suspension) and heated at 60 °C for 30 min. Excess Na (0.5 g, 21.7 mmol) and catalytic naphthalene (10 mg, 78 μmol) were added and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 16 h. The dark greenish-brown solution was filtered, concentrated to 50 mL, layered with hexanes (50 mL), and stood 2 days at room temperature to give crystals of 2 (3.0 g, 1.5 mmol, 42%). Method B: a suspension of 3 (1.0 g, 0.5 mmol) in THF (50 mL) was stirred with Na sand (0.025 g, 1.0 mmol); the solid dissolved to a dark brown solution, which was concentrated, layered with hexane, and afforded crystalline 2 (35%) after 2 days at room temperature.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature; 60 °C for 30 min (method A); crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: method A: 30 min deprotonation, 30 min at 60 °C, 16 h reduction, 2 days crystallization; method B: 2 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: inert N2 atmosphere (drybox or Schlenk/vacuum line)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: method A: filter, concentrate to 50 mL, layer with hexanes (50 mL), stand 2 days; method B: concentrate, layer with hexane, stand 2 days
synthesis.yield: method A 3.0 g, 1.5 mmol, 42%; method B 35%

properties.summary: Room-temperature magnetic moment is lower than that of divalent 1, consistent with mixed/higher Sm oxidation states and possible magnetic coupling across short Sm···Sm contacts; a higher μeff of 6.55 μB is cited in the discussion as a comparison value for 2 versus another analogue.

measurements.name: μeff
measurements.conditions: value given in Results and Discussion for 2 in a comparison with another dinitrogen complex

source_locations.location: Experimental, Preparation of 2, Methods A and B
Experimental (μeff = 4.05 μB); Results and Discussion (also 6.55 μB)

synthesis.procedure: A solution of [(Me3Si)2N]2Sm(THF)2 (1.9 g, 3.0 mmol) in THF (25 mL) was treated with 1,1-dipyrrolylcyclohexane (0.65 g, 3.0 mmol) in THF (20 mL). The mixture instantly became dark brown. Concentration to about 20 mL and standing at room temperature for a few days afforded dark brown crystals of 3 (1.1 g, 0.7 mmol, 70%). Once precipitated, the complex could not be redissolved in common inert solvents.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: inert N2 atmosphere (drybox or Schlenk/vacuum line); transmetalation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: concentrated to ~20 mL; dark brown crystals on standing at room temperature for a few days

properties.summary: Magnetic moment substantially lower than that of mixed-valence 2, consistent with largely trivalent Sm centers in the absence of Na cations.

source_locations.location: Experimental and Results and Discussion (μeff = 3.24 μB)
